allow: PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest "http://localhost:3000/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 120; $css = [regex]::Matches\($r.Content,'/_next/static/[^"]+\\.css'\) | ForEach-Object { $_.Value } | Select-Object -Unique; $css; foreach \($c in $css\) { $t = \(Invoke-WebRequest "http://localhost:3000$c" -UseBasicParsing\).Content; "$c -> montserrat=$\([regex]::Matches\($t,'Montserrat'\).Count\) fontHeadingVar=$\([regex]::Matches\($t,'--font-heading'\).Count\) fontHeadingUtil=$\([regex]::Matches\($t,'\\.font-heading'\).Count\)" })
